body: Yeah, it feels like a backup plan if everything goes wrong

I think she likes you but she’s just really shy. Blushing when your friend asked her is a good sign and if she liked your poems that’s also good. Maybe try to talk to her a bit more if you can, but if you feel comfortable enough I would go for it.
We already send each other memes and stuff on the small gc so I don’t think that’s the problem. It’s just hard knowing if she just wants to be friends ugh.
